payment_merchants.description: Exact payment merchants after trim / uppercase / whitespace collapse.

usd_debt_abono_merchant.description: Substring naming the payment of the USD debt («ABONO DE DIVISAS»).

traspaso_deuda_tokens.description: Every token must appear for a traspaso de deuda (USD debt moved onto the CLP side).

clp_section3_charge_pattern.description: Case-insensitive regex: a CLP section-3 charge (interest, fees, taxes, notas de crédito).

clp_section3_settlement_pattern.description: Case-insensitive regex: a CLP section-3 line that is no financing cost (a cuota plan the bank prepaid, billed whole).

usd_section3_pattern.description: Case-insensitive regex: a USD section-3 line.

usd_garbled_merchant_pattern.description: Case-insensitive regex: a USD row made of two merged pdftotext lines.

printed_payment_prefix_pattern.description: Case-insensitive regex: a payment line opens like this and prints negative (or is an exact payment merchant).

operaciones_layouts.description: CLP layouts read from the printed operaciones (section 1): every row sums there, whatever the merchant.

section3_layouts.description: CLP layouts read from the printed section 3: a payment is a mid-period payment, every other row nets into section 3.

mid_period_payment_layouts.description: CLP layouts whose rows are payments printed as lines.

merchant_rule_layouts.description: Layouts whose reader does not track the printed section (rows of several sections share them): the merchant rules place each row. Any other layout is an error.
